Markets.title: Madhusudan Kela’s portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
Markets.summary: As of August 14, investor Madhusudan Kela’s 19-stock portfolio was valued at approximately Rs 2,665 crore. Performance among the holdings varied significantly, with seven stocks surging between 10% and 135%, while five declined by 15% to 30%.

Markets.title: Bitcoin near $63,000 as weaker ETF demand and cancelled SEC meeting dampen crypto sentiment
Markets.summary: Bitcoin hovered near $63,000 as declining ETF demand and a cancelled SEC meeting weighed on the cryptocurrency market. This uncertainty caused both Bitcoin and Ethereum to drop, pulling the total crypto market cap down by 0.4%.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty consolidation to continue says Sudeep Shah; gives Tata Motors, Lenskart, Honasa strategy
Markets.summary: The Nifty index is expected to continue its range-bound consolidation, supported by strong Put writing and a key support level between 24,150 and 24,200. Analysts recommend specific strategies for stocks like Tata Motors and Honasa while favoring sectors such as PSU banks, auto, defense, and chemicals.

Markets.title: IPO rush: 5 companies to raise Rs 5,499 crore next week; Shiprocket, 4 others to list
Markets.summary: Five companies will raise Rs 5,499.32 crore through initial public offerings between August 17 and 21. Additionally, five recently completed IPOs, including Shiprocket, are scheduled to list next week.

Markets.title: Concurrent Losers: 11 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
Markets.summary: The Sensex dropped 490 points over five sessions through August 14 as 23 BSE 500 stocks declined daily. Eleven of those stocks fell by more than 5%, led by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail, Physicswallah, and Techno Electric & Engineering.

Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk| Where is the value? Sachin Bajaj favours financials, healthcare, capex plays
Markets.summary: Axis Max Life CIO Sachin Bajaj is optimistic about Indian equities due to recovering earnings, moderate valuations, and strong domestic flows. He recommends investing in financials, healthcare, capital goods, digital platforms, and manufacturing, while advising caution regarding expensive stocks.

Geo-Political.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
Geo-Political.summary: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck the Indonesian island of Flores, killing at least 47 people. A search and rescue operation is currently underway to find survivors.

Geo-Political.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli military strikes in southern Lebanon have killed eleven people. Israel stated the attacks targeted Hezbollah infrastructure in response to previous actions against its soldiers.

Geo-Political.title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit
Geo-Political.summary: BBC lawyers are seeking to subpoena Donald Trump's family members in connection with a Panorama lawsuit. The legal team argues that family members have personal knowledge of Trump's intentions regarding his speech outside the US Capitol on January 6, 2021.

Geo-Political.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported aboard
Geo-Political.summary: A U.S. aircraft carrier is deploying to replace the USS Lincoln following reports of food shortages and broken plumbing aboard the ship. The poor living conditions led some sailors to consider jumping overboard.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
Geo-Political.summary: South Korean politician Lee Jae Myung has proposed holding official talks to end the ongoing conflict with North Korea. The Korean War has remained frozen under an armistice agreement since 1953 without a formal peace treaty.

Geo-Political.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
Geo-Political.summary: A father and his two young sons spent 16 hours stranded at sea after their jet ski capsized off the coast of Koh Samui, Thailand. Coast guard and local rescue teams successfully located and saved the family after their overnight ordeal.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Price pressures, youth unemployment, chairman exit
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly Plain Facts compilation uses easy-to-read charts to provide data-driven insights into stories reported by Mint. The topics covered include price pressures, youth unemployment, and a chairman exit.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation decreased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation rates for primary articles and manufactured products both increased compared to June.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India’s merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports grew by 17% to $173.78 billion during the April-July period compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding future interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, compounded by the risks of elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year due to a strong economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

India.title: Bar Council Chief Apologises After Order 'Banning' Students From Becoming Lawyers
India.summary: The Bar Council chief apologized after issuing an order that banned students from becoming lawyers because they opposed a Chief Justice's convocation invitation. This controversy originated when students from the NALSAR University of Law in Hyderabad protested the visit.

India.title: In Congress vs Congress, Punjab Chief's Ticket Stance Publicly Contradicted
India.summary: Former Punjab chief minister Charanjit Singh Channi and Randhawa shared a stage at Issru without state Congress chief Amarinder Singh Raja Warring. This absence highlighted a growing factional divide within the Punjab Congress regarding ticket stances.

India.title: Man Climbs Car Roof To Stop Girlfriend, Her Lover Runs Him Over
India.summary: When his girlfriend attempted to drive away, Parampreet climbed onto the roof of her car to stop her. The driver's lover continued speeding and ran the man over.

India.title: Man Stops On Bridge For Selfie With Infant Daughter, Throws Her Into Yamuna
India.summary: A man stopped on a bridge near Agra to take a selfie with his infant daughter. He then threw the child into the Yamuna river.

India.title: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Recruitment 2026: Apply Online For 24,752 Vacancies, Check Fee Details
India.summary: Rajasthan has announced recruitment for 24,752 Safai Karmchari positions starting on August 15, 2026. Applicants can check the official website for details regarding application dates, OTR fees, and the online application form.

India.title: After Vijay's "Father" Remark, Row Over BJP Leader's "Ask Mother" Comment
India.summary: A BJP leader made a controversial "ask mother" comment following a remark about a "father" by actor Vijay. In response, Vijay's party, the TVK, criticized the BJP politician and urged him to uphold the dignity of his position.

General.title: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM
General.summary: Prime Minister and Andy Burnham have expressed sadness over the death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday. They described the passing as a tragedy on multiple levels and a very sorry state of affairs.

General.title: Analysis: Arday's death will send shockwaves through a divided academia
General.summary: Professor Arday's death will severely impact the UK academic community, where Black professors make up less than one percent of the total. He was part of a very small and highly visible minority within British higher education.

General.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
General.summary: A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake has killed at least 47 people on the Indonesian island of Flores. Search and rescue operations are currently underway to find survivors.

General.title: Thousands of Bonnie Tyler fans line the streets as coffin taken to Swansea home
General.summary: The Total Eclipse of the Heart singer died last month in a hospital in Portugal.

General.title: Met Police apologises for data breach involving alleged Al Fayed victims
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police apologized for a data breach after mistakenly exposing the email addresses of individuals signed up for updates regarding allegations against Mohamed Al Fayed. Scotland Yard accidentally included all subscribers in the "To" field of a monthly update email.

General.title: Sellers puzzled by bulk orders suspect secondhand books being destroyed to train AI
General.summary: Independent booksellers are receiving suspicious bulk orders for novels that are shipped to distant warehouses. Sellers suspect these secondhand books are being systematically destroyed to train artificial intelligence models.
